description: Get detailed information about all bridges

fields.name: modelKey
fields.description: The model key of the bridge

fields.name: guid
fields.description: Stable identifier for the device model.

fields.name: mac
fields.description: The primary MAC address of the device.

fields.name: clients
fields.description: Array of IoT devices mac that bridge is reserving for

fields.name: maxClients
fields.description: The max acceptable client number of a V2 bridge. V1 bridge does not support this feature.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/bridges", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get all bridges
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/bridges"
    method: GET
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
